title: Redo CI-overlap design note, grounded in existing landing code
summary: Retry of job 20261110-191311-r241: rewrite docs/design/overlap-ci-waits.md after surveying the code, so it targets the waits that really remain (take_baseline before the producer, and the ci_wait_s checks poll before the verifier), cites throughput review 20261110-191047-6szm, and scores a stage that spans both waits. Audience: Athena maintainers and the next throughput review.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check quoted rules, cited code paths and measurement against real job timestamps.
Numbers are cited to records or labeled estimates.
The next throughput review scores the predicted saving.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs (take_baseline), crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs (candidate push to athena/ci/<job>, checks polling up to ci_wait_s), crates/athena-core/src/gh/early.rs, crates/athena-core/src/status/throughput.rs, docs/design/agent-and-build-slots.md, docs/design/per-job-main-landing.md, docs/design/continuous-landing.md, docs/design/ci-routing.md, docs/design/warm-baseline-build.md.

Environment: reads only the repository copy (docs and Rust sources) and recorded job.json/invocation timestamps already cited in docs; no CI runs, pushes or PRs are made. The note only describes the existing push to athena/ci/<job>, the early PR and the CI workflow trigger on athena/ci/**; read-only, no write permissions needed.

Prior job 20261110-191311-r241 findings addressed: (1) change 3 (push candidate when producer ends) already exists at run/mod.rs ~1946-1953 and gh/early.rs ~343; the note says what exists and targets only the remaining checks poll before the verifier. (2) Scoring: the note names a measure that spans both waits (dispatch-to-producer-start and producer-end-to-verifier-start gaps from job.json/invocation timestamps, or a proposed new wait stage), since the checks stage excludes CI waits; checked against a real recent job. (3) Base-CI wait is cited as take_baseline in run/checks.rs, with ci-routing.md and warm-baseline-build.md; rules are quoted from the docs, not invented. (4) CHANGELOG.md entry is added; the earlier out-of-scope line against CHANGELOG.md was a contradiction and is dropped.
Files the earlier candidate changed: CHANGELOG.md, docs/design/overlap-ci-waits.md and docs/design/per-job-main-landing.md are all kept as deliverables, but rewritten from the base, not reused.
Predicted saving is the throughput review's 8.0 minutes per landed job against the 2708.1 median, labeled an estimate; the note must say if the code survey lowers it.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/overlap-ci-waits.md exists and describes starting the producer without waiting on base CI, using the base result only at the checks, and running the verifier alongside the CI wait; Grep for 'base', 'CI', 'take_baseline' and 'ci_wait_s' in it.

The design has an Existing code section that reuses or extends crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs, crates/athena-core/src/gh/early.rs, docs/design/agent-and-build-slots.md, docs/design/per-job-main-landing.md and docs/design/continuous-landing.md, naming for each proposed change the file and function that does it today or saying none does, and stating which rules change.

The Existing code section says the candidate push to athena/ci/<job> already exists (run/mod.rs, gh/early.rs) and says what, if anything, still changes; every rule attributed to a doc is a quoted line that Grep finds in that doc, and every cited path and line exists.
The note cites throughput review 20261110-191047-6szm by id and states the predicted saving of 8.0 minutes per landed job (labeled an estimate) against the 2708.1 median.

The measurement section names a stage or gap measure that includes both CI waits (checked against crates/athena-core/src/status/throughput.rs, where checks excludes them), says the next throughput review compares its median minutes per landed job to the prediction, and shows it checked against at least one real recent job's timestamps.
The note lists alternatives and risks (base CI failing after the producer ran, wasted work) with the handling of each.

CHANGELOG.md has a new entry for the design note; git diff --stat shows only docs/design/overlap-ci-waits.md, docs/design/per-job-main-landing.md and CHANGELOG.md changed, with no crates/, xtask/, athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow file changes.

out_of_scope: Implementing the change in crates/ or xtask/
Changing athena.toml, defaults.toml or CI workflows
Changing docs other than the new note and the cross-reference in per-job-main-landing.md
departures: Retry of a design job that failed on code-grounding; slightly lower acceptance and pass odds than the reference.
